title: Hurricane Maria: 10K Blue Roof Install
description: In conjunction with FEMA, the U.S. Army Corps installed the ten thousandth blue roof in the city of Bayamon.
keywords: FEMA, Bayamon, Maria, blue, VIPR, 10K, USACE, engineer, Hurricane, roof, Puerto Rico
unit_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Omaha District

transcript.text: (dramatic music)
^- [Mike] For the past 25 years,
^Carlo Rivera has called this house in Bayamon home.
^Like many of his neighbors and fellow Puerto Ricans,
Hurricane Maria left her mark on his castle.
^(speaking foreign language)
In conjunction with FEMA, Carlo's home is
the 10,000th blue roof the US Army Corps of Engineers
has installed on the island.
To be eligible for the program, the home must have
a non-flat roof and have less than 50% structural damage.
^- The Blue Roof Program is an operation that puts
^a temporary covering or plastic sheeting
^over the top of residents' homes to
allow them to get out of a shelter
and get back into their homes to return to some sense
of normalcy after the hurricane.
- [Mike] For everyone involved, from the USACE
team members going door-to-door assessing the homes
to the contractors doing the installation,
this has been anything but just another day at the office.
- So to be able to come in and help a family
^live in a house that used to be wet when it rained
^and now is dry and safe and healthy
^is a big satisfaction for us.
^Not only for me, for all the workers on the roof,
because, as we said in one of our meetings,
"Think of it as one of these houses
"might be your grandmother's house,
"it might be your sister's house."
So all the workers as well as the people coming in
from off the island, it's really rewarding in that sense.
^- Being here in Puerto Rico and especially in Bayamon,
^knowing that we are giving the people from Bayamon
the opportunity to come back home is very important to me,
even more that this is my hometown,
so it has a special meaning for me, too.
- [Mike] And for those like Carlo and his family,
the fix may be temporary but the effect is long-lasting.
^(speaks foreign language)
USACE estimates that about 60,000 homes
^will eventually be covered by the Blue Roof Program.
^Mike Glasch, US Army Corps of Engineers,
^Puerto Rico. (speaks foreign language)
